note: Tonga: nationals of the countries with bilateral agreements enter without a visa for 90 days in 180 (the Schengen states, the EU but Ireland, and Israel), 60 (the UAE) or 30 (China); nationals of the countries listed get a free visa on arrival for 31 days (extendable to 6 months, not modelled); everyone else applies to the Principal Immigration Officer for a visa beforehand. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Read on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry of Revenue and Customs' own immigration page (as Common Crawl captured it on 5 October 2026; the live page sends an incomplete TLS chain): it is undated and knows none of Tonga's visa waiver agreements (the EU's, Israel's, the UAE's, China's) that Wikipedia's copy records, giving the European states it names a 30-day visa on arrival instead, so it is older than they are and is recorded here and not held. It confirms that everyone not listed needs a visa before arrival.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Tonga
sources.said: Visitors to Tonga must obtain a visa unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries or citizens who may obtain a free visa on arrival. Visa applications must be sent to the Principal Immigration Officer in Nuku'alofa . ... 90 days within any 180 days European Union member states (except Ireland) Iceland Israel Liechtenstein Norway Switzerland 60 days United Arab Emirates 30 days China ... Citizens of the following countries and territories may obtain a free visa on arrival (valid for 31 days, extendable to 6 months): Australia Bahamas Barbados Brazil Brunei Canada Dominica Fiji Hong Kong Ireland Japan Kiribati Malaysia Macau Marshall Islands Micronesia Monaco Nauru New Zealand Palau Papua New Guinea Russia Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa Seychelles Singapore Solomon Islands South Korea Turkey Tuvalu Ukraine United Kingdom United States Vanuatu

sources.title: Ministry of Revenue and Customs (Tonga), Immigration and General Services (Common Crawl capture CC-MAIN-2026-43, 2026-10-05)
sources.said: Visitors entitled to visa free entry (or visa on arrival) Travellers who are citizens of the following countries may be issued a 30 day visitor visa on arrival into Tonga: Australia, Austria Barbados, Belgium, Brazil, Brunei Darussalam Canada, Cook Islands, Cyprus Denmark, Dominica Federated States of Micronesia, Fiji, Finland, France, French Polynesia Germany, Greece Ireland, Italy Japan, Kiribati Luxembourg Malaysia, Malta, Marshall Islands, Monaco Nauru, Netherlands, New Zealand, Niue,Norway Palau, Papua New Guinea, Portugal Russia Samoa, Seychelles, Singapore, Solomon Islands, Spain, St Kitts & Nevis, St Lucia, St Vincent & the Grenadines, Sweden, Switzerland The Bahamas, Turkey, Tuvalu Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States of America Vanuatu Visa Requirement Citizens of all other countries need visas to enter Tonga (prior to arrival). A genuine visitor intending to visit Tonga for a period of not less than 30 days is required to obtain an entry permit issued by the Immigration Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs prior to arriving in Tonga.
